fusions.name: Cramp Bolt
fusions.desc: Flings an iron cramp that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Sundered] for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target, and uses it up.

fusions.name: Cold Filing Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays cold iron filings ahead of you, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles in front, ignoring resistances, with a 50% chance to leave each one [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Banded Course
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 10%.

fusions.name: Unyielding Bond
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, you gain a ward that absorbs damage equal to 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
